informal_statement:
For any real \(\lambda\) and Euclidean set \(S\) with
\[
\mathcal H^1(S)<\infty,
\]
the Euclidean strip density is integrable over \(S\) against \(\mathcal H^1\).
reason: Source `FrontierPerimeter.lean:1404-1411`: Finite Hausdorff measure and globally bounded measurable density give integrability for every real density parameter; no set-measurability premise is added.
